A [[Wood/Legends|wooden]] '''bridge''' spanned a deep chasm beneath the [[Dawn Temple]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Spintir/Legends|Spintir]].<ref name="Mountaintop Rescue" />

==Behind the scenes==
The bridge appears in ''[[Mountaintop Rescue]]'', the adventure in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[2015]] ''[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Beginner Game]]''.
